item.title: TwitchAdBlock v30.7
item.description:
Twitch 30.7 | TwitchAdBlock 0.1.13
**TwitchMods v0.1.13** — for Twitch iOS **30.7**
### New in v0.1.13 - **Casting & AirPlay now work with ad-blocking on.** Previously, having the ad-block proxy enabled could make casting to a Chromecast crash after a few seconds, or make AirPlay to an Apple TV show "offline." The mod now automatically steps aside while you're casting/AirPlaying, so the stream plays on the TV — and your phone goes right back to blocking ads the moment you stop. (The stream *on the TV* still shows ads — the TV fetches the video itself, so that can't be blocked — but your phone stays ad-free.)
### Everything else (v0.1.12) - Blocks ads (live + VOD pre-rolls, feed banners, sponsor spots, the "Go Ad-Free" Turbo button) - Keep Live Feed Playing · 7TV/BTTV/FFZ chat emotes + Reload · settings backup/restore · Diagnostics · launch screen · hide Stories
### Downloads - **`tv.twitch-30.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.13.ipa`** — full app. - **`tv.twitch-30.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.13-noplugins.ipa`** — app extensions removed so a free Apple ID only uses 1 App ID slot when sideloading.
Install with **AltStore / SideStore** (drag in the IPA) or **TrollStore** (tap +, pick the IPA).
Full plain-language changelog: [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)

item.title: TwitchAdBlock v29.4.2
item.description:
Twitch 29.4.2 | tv.twitch-29.4.2-TwitchAdBlock
## Highlights
- **Launch Screen picker** — choose which tab Twitch opens to. Includes Home sub-tabs (Following / Live / Clips) and Browse sub-tabs (Categories / Live Channels), plus Activity and Profile. - **Hide Twitch Stories** — toggle to remove the horizontal Stories strip at the top of Home. - **Default-proxy reachability indicator** in TwitchMods settings — live Online / Offline / Checking status. - **New banner blocking** — McDonalds-style brand offers (`OfferPromotion`, `PromotionDisplay`) and the in-app "buy Bits" prompt (`BitsProductPromotion`) are removed from Following / Home responses. - **TwitchMods rebrand** — user-facing strings (settings entry, screen title, version footer) now read "TwitchMods". Internal symbols, keys, and dylib filename unchanged. - **AdBlock proxy on by default** for fresh installs.
## Bug fixes
- **Live & Clips tabs broken** after the previous release — the recursive GraphQL strip was orphaning edges in `feedItems.edges`. Now edge-aware (removes the whole edge when `edge.node.__typename` matches), and skips response re-serialization when nothing was actually stripped (was confusing Apollo's cache). - Speculative ad typenames (`AdProperties`, `PromotedContent`, `SponsoredContent`, etc.) removed from the blocklist — several were appearing as metadata fields on legitimate `Stream` / `Clip` objects.
## Robustness / quality
- Subdomain-aware ad host matching (now blocks `*.amazon-adsystem.com`). - LRU eviction for the emote registry (capped at 50 channels). - IRC emote positions counted as Unicode grapheme clusters instead of UTF-16 units — emoji no longer shift the rendered offsets. - Recursive `__typename` scan logs unknown ad-like values once per `(operation, typename)`, so new banners surface in logs without code archaeology. - `twab_warnIfClassMissing` runs at startup for every Swift hook target — silent feature regressions on a Twitch version bump now produce a visible warning. - Typed `TWABKey*` constants instead of `@"..."` literals — typos become compile errors. - Atomic synthetic-emote-ID generator (one less queue hop per registration). - WebSocket handler idempotent (associated-object marker) + non-IRC frames short-circuit before parsing. - Settings cells properly reuse via `dequeueReusableCellWithIdentifier:`. - Proxy address field saves on every keystroke (not just end-editing). - Deprecated `[tweakDefaults synchronize]` calls removed.
## Install
Sideload the attached IPA via AltStore / SideStore (drag in) or TrollStore (`ldid -S` the inner binary first).
Full diff: [v0.1.7...v0.1.8](https://github.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/compare/ee614b7...v0.1.8)
